name: Endowed
source:
You get a call out of the blue that your uncle that you haven't seen in over a decade has passed. 

When you go to pay your respects, you find that he has left you an inheritance that includes a highly profitable gentleman's club. The catch is that before you can become full owner, you have to do one thing: 

Get married.

Date a variety of girls to find the right one, all while uncovering who it was that killed your uncle.

[From [url=https://expandinguniverse.itch.io/endowed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你突然接到一个电话，说你十多年没见的叔叔去世了。

当你去表达敬意时，你发现他给你留下了一笔遗产，其中包括一家利润丰厚的绅士俱乐部。问题是，在你成为完全所有者之前，你必须做一件事：

结婚吧。

与各种各样的女孩约会，找到合适的那个，同时找出杀死你叔叔的凶手。

[来自[url=https://expandinguniverse.itch.io/endowed]Itch.io[/url]]
